description: Bornes de Recharge pour Véhicules Electriques (IRVE) - réseau IZIVIA déployé par m2A is a dataset listed in m2A open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. Localisation et informations sur les bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques déployées par m2A dans le cadre du réseau IZIVIA. Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are bornes, IRVE, électrique, voiture, recharge, véhicule. The portal shows 112 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-mulhouse-alsace-fr-portal.
